added: [[Category:Cleaning Cooking Appliances]]
[[Category:Outdoor Cooking]]
=== Cleaning a Foreman Grill with Removable Plates ===

# Remove the grill plates one at a time. This is where the oven mitts come in handy. Once you’ve taken the plates out of the grill, place them on your counter.<ref>https://www.leaf.tv/articles/how-to-clean-a-george-foreman-grill/</ref>
#* You should lay out paper towels so you don’t risk the grill plates damaging any part of your kitchen counter.

# Wash the grill plates in the dishwasher. The plates are completely dishwasher-friendly, so you don’t need to change any settings or add any more dishwasher detergent to get them clean. If possible, wash the grill plates with a smaller load to give them the best chance to get clean.<ref>https://www.leaf.tv/articles/how-to-clean-a-george-foreman-grill/</ref>
=== Cleaning a Foreman Grill without Removable Plates ===

# Close the grill to let the paper towels absorb the grease. The paper towels will loosen the grease and make it easier to scrub away. To save time, set this up right before you eat. By the time you’re done, you’ll be able to remove the damp paper towels and the grill will be ready to clean. The grill should be warm when you do this, but if it is too uncomfortable to touch, wait for it to cool off a bit more.<ref>https://food.thefuntimesguide.com/george-foreman-grill/</ref>

# Spray the grilling surface with a spray bottle immediately after cooking. This is another way to clean your Foreman if you don’t want to put paper towels in it. Start spraying once you’ve unplugged the grill and made sure it’s turned off.<ref>https://foremangrillrecipes.com/how-to-clean/</ref>

#* If you do not have a spray bottle, you can put a wet paper towel ball between metal tongs and wipe down the surface this way. This allows you to get in between the ridges and reach the more obscure areas of the grill.
#* Don’t directly pour water onto your grill, as this can damage its electrical wiring if the water finds its way under the grill plates.

# Use a wet sponge or rag to finish cleaning. Add warm water and a small amount of soap to a sponge, rag, or paper towel to get rid of any residue that is still on your grill. Wipe the inside of your grill thoroughly.<ref>https://foremangrillrecipes.com/how-to-clean/</ref>
#* Take time to wipe all parts of the grill, as grease can get anywhere. You want your grill looking fresh and clean for the next time you use it!

# Pour grease out of the drip tray and wipe it down by hand. The drip tray catches the excess grease that comes from your food, so there’s a good chance it’s full once you’re done cooking. Pour the grease into your sink and use a rag with warm water to scrub away the remaining residue.<ref>https://foremangrillrecipes.com/how-to-clean/</ref>
#* You can use a paper towel to clean the drip tray instead of a rag if you’d like.
#* The drip tray should be clean once you’ve wiped it down. However, if you want to play it safe and make sure it’s as clean as it can be, stick it in the dishwasher after you’ve cleaned your grill.
== Tips ==

*To prevent your Foreman from getting messy in the first place, lay 1 long piece of aluminum foil on the grill before you turn it on and start cooking. Don’t use 2 aluminum pieces because you’ll risk grease dripping onto the grill. Aluminum foil does not change the cook time for your food, so go through the same routine you would without foil. Parchment paper, also known as baking paper, is another option if you don’t have aluminum foil.
removed: [[Category:Barbecue]]
=== Cleaning a Foreman Grill with Removeable Plates ===

# Remove the grill plates one at a time. This is where the oven mitts come in handy. Once you’ve taken the plates out of the grill, you have a couple of options for cleaning them. You can put the plates in the dishwasher with everything else, or soak them in water by themselves.<ref>https://www.leaf.tv/articles/how-to-clean-a-george-foreman-grill/</ref>
=== Using Aluminum Foil to Clean Your Foreman Grill ===

# Lay 1 long piece of aluminum foil across the grill. Do this before you turn on the grill. It’s better to use 1 long piece than 2 shorter pieces because you don’t want to risk the chance of the grill plate being bare. If any part of the grill plate is exposed, grease can drip under the foil and add time to the cleaning process.<ref>https://food.thefuntimesguide.com/george-foreman-grill/</ref>
#* Aluminum foil does not change the cook time for your food, so follow the same routine you would use without the foil.
#* Parchment paper, or baking paper, works just as well as aluminum foil.

# Remove the food from the foil when you’re done grilling. Use a spatula, fork, or other utensil to transfer the food. Turn the grill off right after you’ve done this. As you eat, the grill will cool down. Once you’ve finished your meal, check to see if the grill and foil have cooled off.<ref>https://food.thefuntimesguide.com/george-foreman-grill/</ref>
#* Do not try to remove the food from the foil by hand, as both the foil and the grill will be extremely hot.

# Take the foil off the grill plates and throw it away. Wait for the foil and grill to cool off before trashing the foil. Remove the foil by grabbing both sides of it and making a bowl-shape out of it. This keeps the grease from spilling back onto the grill or your counter.<ref>https://food.thefuntimesguide.com/george-foreman-grill/</ref>
#* One small downside to using aluminum foil is that you don’t get those dark grill marks on your food. If you want nice, even grill marks, use a different method to clean your grill.
=== Placing Paper Towels on Your Foreman Grill After Cooking ===

# Close the grill to let the paper towels absorb the grease. The paper towels will loosen the grease and make it easier to scrub away. To save time, set this up right before you eat. By the time you’re done, you’ll be able to remove the damp paper towels and the grill will be ready to clean.<ref>https://food.thefuntimesguide.com/george-foreman-grill/</ref>

# Wipe away any remaining residue with a wet rag. Put mild dish soap on the rag and scrub away whatever residue is left. Go over the surface multiple times to make sure you didn’t miss any grease spots.<ref>https://food.thefuntimesguide.com/george-foreman-grill/</ref>
#* Make sure to use warm water for the rag.

#* Sometimes, the steam from the paper towels eliminates everything, which means you don’t need soap and water after the fact! Still, be sure to check for residue that’s been left over and use the rag and soap just to be safe.
=== Spritzing Water on the Grill After Cooking ===

# Spray the grilling surface with water immediately after cooking. Do this once you’ve unplugged the grill and made sure it’s turned off. You can also put a wet paper towel ball between metal tongs and wipe down the surface this way. This allows you to get in between the ridges and reach the more obscure areas of the grill.<ref>https://foremangrillrecipes.com/how-to-clean/</ref>

# Scrub the grill after it’s cooled down with a wet rag. You can use a wad of paper towels or a sponge if you’d like. Whichever you pick, add a small amount of dish soap and thoroughly wipe the grill plates.<ref>https://foremangrillrecipes.com/how-to-clean/</ref>
#* Not only should you wipe the inside of the grill, you should go over the edges if any fat has dripped.

# Use a wet sponge or rag to finish cleaning. Only add warm water to a sponge, rag, or paper towel to get rid of any grease, soap, or other residue that is still on your grill. Wipe the inside and outside of your grill to leave it looking fresh and clean for the next time you use it.<ref>https://foremangrillrecipes.com/how-to-clean/</ref>
#* At this point, the drip tray is all that’s left to clean. You can scrub it by hand with warm water and soap, or place it in the dishwasher.

== Steps ==
=== Cleaning a Foreman Grill with Removeable Plates ===

# Unplug the Foreman after using it. Give it about 10-15 minutes to cool down. If the grill is still hot after that time, wait a little longer to avoid any injuries.<ref>https://theindoorgrill.com/how-to-clean-george-foreman-grill/</ref>

#* While using a dishwasher will clean the grill plates, soaking them separately lets you clean them completely.

# Soak the grill plates in warm, soapy water in your sink. Fill the water to the halfway point of the sink and add a few drops of dish soap. Keep your grill plates completely submerged in the water and let them sit for a few minutes.<ref>https://www.leaf.tv/articles/how-to-clean-a-george-foreman-grill/</ref>
#* You can use a bathroom sink to do this if your kitchen sink does not have room.

# Dry the grill plates with a towel before reattaching them. Use a soft towel to scrub away any excess food particles or soap. Once the plates are completely dry, reattach them to your Foreman Grill.<ref>https://www.leaf.tv/articles/how-to-clean-a-george-foreman-grill/</ref>

#* Since the Foreman has electrical wiring inside of it, you must wait for the plates to dry before putting them back in the grill. The wiring can short-circuit if it comes into contact with the water.
=== Using Aluminum Foil to Clean Your Foreman Grill ===

# Lay 1 long piece of aluminum foil across the grill. Do this before you turn on the grill. It’s better to use 1 long piece than 2 shorter pieces because you don’t want to risk the chance of the grill plate being bare. If any part of the grill plate is exposed, grease can drip under the foil and add time to the cleaning process.<ref>https://food.thefuntimesguide.com/george-foreman-grill/</ref>

#* Parchment paper, or baking paper, works just as well as aluminum foil.

As you eat, the grill will cool down. Once you’ve finished your meal, check to see if the grill and foil have cooled off.<ref>https://food.thefuntimesguide.com/george-foreman-grill/</ref>
#* Do not try to remove the food from the foil by hand, as both the foil and the grill will be extremely hot.

# Take the foil off the grill plates and throw it away. Wait for the foil and grill to cool off before trashing the foil. Remove the foil by grabbing both sides of it and making a bowl-shape out of it. This keeps the grease from spilling back onto the grill or your counter.<ref>https://food.thefuntimesguide.com/george-foreman-grill/</ref>
#* One small downside to using aluminum foil is that you don’t get those dark grill marks on your food. If you want nice, even grill marks, use a different method to clean your grill.
=== Placing Paper Towels on Your Foreman Grill After Cooking ===

# Put damp paper towels on your grill once it has cooled down. This helps lift the grease that accumulates on the grill. Place three layers of lightly damp paper towels on the grill plates, as just one paper towel will be ineffective.<ref>https://foremangrillrecipes.com/how-to-clean/</ref>
#* Don’t do any of this until you’ve unplugged the grill and waited a few minutes for it to cool down. If you put paper towels down when the grill is still hot, it could cause a fire.

# Close the grill to let the paper towels absorb the grease. The paper towels will loosen the grease and make it easier to scrub away. To save time, set this up right before you eat. By the time you’re done, you’ll be able to remove the damp paper towels and the grill will be ready to clean.<ref>https://food.thefuntimesguide.com/george-foreman-grill/</ref>

#* Even though you don’t want to put paper towels on a hot grill, you do want your Foreman to be somewhat warm when you layer the paper towels on it. The mix of the grill’s warmth and the paper towels’ moisture is necessary to lift the grease out of the grill plates.

# Wipe away any remaining residue with a wet rag. Put mild dish soap on the rag and scrub away whatever residue is left. Go over the surface multiple times to make sure you didn’t miss any grease spots.<ref>https://food.thefuntimesguide.com/george-foreman-grill/</ref>
#* Make sure to use warm water for the rag.

#* Sometimes, the steam from the paper towels eliminates everything, which means you don’t need soap and water after the fact! Still, be sure to check for residue that’s been left over and use the rag and soap just to be safe.
=== Spritzing Water on the Grill After Cooking ===

# Spray the grilling surface with water immediately after cooking. Do this once you’ve unplugged the grill and made sure it’s turned off. You can also put a wet paper towel ball between metal tongs and wipe down the surface this way. This allows you to get in between the ridges and reach the more obscure areas of the grill.<ref>https://foremangrillrecipes.com/how-to-clean/</ref>
#* This step takes place while the grill is still fairly hot, so be careful not to burn yourself.

# Scrub the grill after it’s cooled down with a wet rag. You can use a wad of paper towels or a sponge if you’d like. Whichever you pick, add a small amount of dish soap and thoroughly wipe the grill plates.<ref>https://foremangrillrecipes.com/how-to-clean/</ref>
#* Not only should you wipe the inside of the grill, you should go over the edges if any fat has dripped.

# Chip away at fat and food chunks with your plastic scraper. The scraper comes with the Foreman grill. If you’ve lost it or do not have one for some reason, use a plastic spatula to get rid of the excess food chunks.<ref>https://food.thefuntimesguide.com/george-foreman-grill/</ref>
#* Make sure you use a plastic scraper, as metal can damage the Foreman grill.

# Use a wet sponge or rag to finish cleaning. Only add warm water to a sponge, rag, or paper towel to get rid of any grease, soap, or other residue that is still on your grill. Wipe the inside and outside of your grill to leave it looking fresh and clean for the next time you use it.<ref>https://foremangrillrecipes.com/how-to-clean/</ref>
#* At this point, the drip tray is all that’s left to clean. You can scrub it by hand with warm water and soap, or place it in the dishwasher.

#Place damp paper towels between the grill lid and the surface.  Press down (like you are actually cooking the paper towels) and allow the towels to steam between the grates.[[Image:Clean a Foreman Grill Step 3.jpg|center]]

#Open grill and remove damp paper towels. Take care during this step to avoid getting burned.[[Image:Clean a Foreman Grill Step 4.jpg|center]]
#*Discard paper towels.
#Wipe grill grates dry with two dry paper towels. You may want to wait a few seconds to allow the grill to cool completely before drying.[[Image:Clean a Foreman Grill Step 5.jpg|center]]

Rather than create a fire hazard and ignore the problem, here’s a very simple way to keep the surface clean (and safe).
==Steps==
#Unplug grill immediately after use.  That means that the grill will still be extremely hot.

#*Hold in place a few seconds, allowing the water to steam the grates, lifting debris off the grill.
#Open grill and remove damp paper towels. Take care during this step to avoid getting burned.
#*Discard paper towels.
#Wipe grill grates dry with two dry paper towels. You may want to wait a few seconds to allow the grill to cool completely before drying.
==Things You’ll Need==
*Hot George Foreman Grill
*Roll of paper towels
*Water
==Tips==
